aboutPage.heroSubtitle: EventPartner was founded on one idea: to make enterprise event planning as seamless as booking a hotel room. With a network spanning 175 countries and deep industry expertise, we make it possible — every day.
aboutPage.storyQuote: We believe every event is an opportunity to build something lasting. Not just a conference — a memory. Not just a dinner — a relationship.
aboutPage.storyBody1: Based in the Mediterranean and Scandinavia but operating around the globe, EventPartner connects enterprises with the perfect venue for any occasion. From intimate board dinners to 5,000-person corporate conferences, our team of seasoned event professionals curates tailored proposals — fast.
aboutPage.storyBody2: Our backgrounds span event production, hospitality, and technology. We combined all three to create a service that is personal, reliable, and remarkably efficient. One inquiry, multiple options, zero hassle.

values.title: Personal Service
values.description: Every inquiry is handled by a real person, not a chatbot. We believe in relationships built on trust and genuine care.

values.title: Speed & Reliability
values.description: Proposals within 24 hours, always. We know that time-critical event planning doesn't wait for anyone.

values.title: Global Reach
values.description: One partner across 175 countries. No more juggling local agencies — we handle everything from Stockholm to Barcelona.

values.title: Transparency
values.description: No hidden fees, clear pricing, and a comparison of at least 3 venue options for every single request.

aboutPage.teamIntro: A small team with deep experience in event production, hospitality, and tech — treating every inquiry as their own.
aboutPage.ctaHeadline: Ready to plan your next event?
aboutPage.ctaDescription: Send us your inquiry — always free, always personal, always within 24 hours.

aiAssistant.heroIntro1: Hosting an event is easy compared to getting the right people to actually attend.
aiAssistant.heroIntro2: Whether you're organizing a client day, conference, partner meetup, breakfast seminar, or internal kickoff, the attendees ultimately determine the event's value.
aiAssistant.heroIntro3: The wrong audience often means a cost. The right audience, however, can create new business, strengthen relationships, and generate a return far beyond the investment. That's why EventPartner offers an AI-driven Event Assistant to help you identify, invite, and communicate with the right people before, during, and after the event.
aiAssistant.roiTitle: ROI begins long before the event day
aiAssistant.roiDescription: Many companies allocate huge resources to venues, food, content, and logistics – but significantly less on actual attendee recruitment.
roiIssues: The event yields lower business value than it should
aiAssistant.roiQuote: It doesn't matter how great the event is if the right people aren't there.
aiAssistant.roiStat: According to multiple industry surveys, over 70% of B2B marketers state that events are one of their most effective channels for generating business. Yet, attendee recruitment and follow-up are two of the biggest challenges to creating actual ROI.
aiAssistant.botTitle: A virtual event assistant working around the clock
aiAssistant.botSummary: Our AI Event Assistant helps you:
botFeatures: Identify relevant decision-makers and target groups
Invite attendees via LinkedIn and email
Follow up automatically before the event
Send reminders at the right time
Handle internal communication regarding the event
Ensure higher attendance and better attendee quality
Continue the dialogue after the event
aiAssistant.foundersTitle: Built by people who know sales
aiAssistant.foundersP1: EventPartner's founders have a combined 30+ years of experience in B2B sales, marketing, and business development.
aiAssistant.foundersP2: We know an event isn't just about filling a room.
aiAssistant.foundersP3: It's about creating business value. It's about getting the right people in the right place at the right time.
aiAssistant.foundersP4: And it's about ensuring every invested dollar actually contributes to the company's goals.
aiAssistant.ctaHeadline: Focus on the event – we'll help you fill it
aiAssistant.ctaSub: With our AI Event Assistant, you can focus on what really matters: Creating a fantastic event.
aiAssistant.ctaP1: Meanwhile, our assistant works in the background to identify, contact, follow up, and engage the right attendees.
aiAssistant.ctaP2: The result is higher attendance, better meetings, more business opportunities, and a significantly stronger ROI from every event you host. We look forward to introducing your company to the EP-assistant, and the future way of increasing revenue from your events today!
aiAssistant.ctaButton: Want more info? Book a meeting with us!

securityPage.heroSubtitle: We handle event data for some of Europe's largest organizations. That trust is earned through rigorous security practices, aligning with GDPR standards, and absolute transparency about how we protect your information.

pillars.title: Data Encryption
pillars.description: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). We follow industry best practices for key management and rotation.

pillars.title: EU-Based Infrastructure
pillars.description: All data is hosted on EU-based servers. We do not transfer personal data outside the European Economic Area without explicit safeguards.

pillars.title: GDPR Compliant
pillars.description: EventPartner is designed with GDPR principles in mind. We maintain a detailed data processing register and continually work towards full compliance across all services.

pillars.title: Access Control
pillars.description: Role-based access control (RBAC) ensures that only authorized personnel can access sensitive information. All access is logged and auditable.

pillars.title: Transparency
pillars.description: We publish a clear privacy policy and maintain an open line of communication for any data protection concerns or questions.

pillars.title: Incident Response
pillars.description: We maintain a documented incident response plan with 72-hour notification commitment in accordance with GDPR Article 33.

items: Data Processing Agreements (DPA) with all sub-processors
Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA) for new services
Staff training on data protection and security

securityPage.rightsIntro: Under GDPR, you have extensive rights regarding your personal data. We make it easy to exercise them.

rights.desc: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you.
